request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Change only these colours: every pale blue flame (two on his shoulders, one at each wrist) becomes bright glowing violet with a pale core, nothing blue is left; the green moss on his shoulder plates becomes pale warm ivory bone; his two violet feet become dark charcoal grey boots. Keep everything else exactly the same: the skin, eyes, stitches, iron plates, manacles, chains, smock, belt, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
